_meta.notes: SYNTHETIC, hand-built from real airframe numbers rather than a live capture: an 11-tonne winged vehicle in a clean subsonic climb through 6 km, wing area and coefficients in the range a trainer-sized aeroplane actually flies at. The only scenario in which every field on the Topic has a value, which is why it is the one that shows the widget at full stretch.
_meta.sources: Weight 108 kN and lift 108 kN balance at 1 g; L/D 9.3 and Cd 0.041 are clean-configuration subsonic figures; ballistic coefficient is m/(Cd·A) for the same mass and area.
